$comment: Runner adapters for diff-scoped mutation testing (plan section 4.13, ADR 0003). Each adapter runs mutations only on changed production code (not test code). Used by DoD tier_gates at MEDIUM+. Adapter detection uses stack.json primary_language.

stryker.notes: Stryker v8+ supports --mutate glob filtering. Use --concurrency for speed.

pit.notes: PIT requires class-level targeting. Convert file paths to fully-qualified class names via source roots.

mutmut.notes: mutmut v3+ supports --paths-to-mutate for diff-scoped runs.

cargo-mutants.notes: cargo-mutants --in-diff reads a unified diff file. Generate with: git diff base...head > diff.patch

go-mutesting.notes: go-mutesting targets packages. Convert file paths to Go package paths.

detection.$comment: Map stack.json primary_language to adapter key. When multiple languages exist, the adapter for the changed file's language is used.

tier_gates.$comment: Story risk tier to mutation testing requirement (from DoD policy). null = not required at this tier.
